title: Holosim
description: Holosim is the most accessible way to sample Star Atlas quickly, making it a key conversion tool for first-time visitors.
heroTitle: Holosim makes Star Atlas feel reachable from the first click.
heroSummary: A premium funnel still needs a low-friction on-ramp. Holosim gives new visitors a fast way to understand the ecosystem without losing the sense that they are entering a larger universe.
utilityLine: This page is intentionally direct because its purpose is conversion clarity, not lore density.

heroMedia.label: Browser preview
heroMedia.caption: The lowest-friction path is now treated as a premium entry point, not a side note.

heroPanel.title: This is the first-touch experience the site now prioritizes.
heroPanel.body: Instead of forcing signups or front-loading friction, the redesign lets the visitor begin with a browser-native product surface that still feels part of the larger world.

sections.heading: Holosim is more than a lightweight demo.

cards.title: It lowers the barrier to entry
cards.body: The visitor can engage immediately instead of being blocked by setup, email gates, or ambiguity.

cards.title: It teaches the ecosystem quickly
cards.body: Browser-native interactions make the broader product easier to understand before the user commits more time.

cards.title: It creates a better first conversion event
cards.body: Premium marketing is strongest when it gets the user into a meaningful product moment fast.

items.question: Why prioritize Holosim over a signup form?
items.answer: Because product interaction builds trust faster than an email ask. The redesign moves the first conversion event closer to actual engagement.

items.question: Does this replace the bigger game fantasy?
items.answer: No. It makes that bigger fantasy easier to reach by giving visitors a confident first step.

finalCta.title: Start where the friction is lowest.
finalCta.text: Launch the browser experience now, then expand into economy and ownership systems when you want more depth.
